src/ must never import Module Federation runtime types: those reach
`import webpack from "webpack"`, a package this app does not depend on.

@cytoscape-web/app-runtime declares a local structural type instead, so
    nothing here reaches those declarations.

a directory that does not exist here, and setting it suppresses the
default lookup that actually finds the types.
